@June Osei-Lark: On Jul 1, Gideon said he closed ticket #8841 with support. The fix he described was Vantorre's IT clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard report template worked for their billing team. The channel says nothing more than that. I've replied in your thread.

The Sep 30 strategic digest also lists #8841 as a Dock Door 14 kiosk check-in problem that was escalated to platform engineering, which doesn't match the Jul 1 closure. The ticket's full history in support may be worth checking before you rely on it.
